IC1: At least 18 years of age at the time of screening
IC2: Have stable renal function for one month (30 days) prior to enrollment
IC3: Have Chronic HCV infection [AND] prior to transplantation with documented HCV viremia = 1,000 IU/ml at screening and either documented HCV Ab [OR] positivity or HCV viremia = 1,000 IU/ml at least 6 months prior to enrollment.
IC4: Documented genotype 1 HCV infection prior to enrollment and after their transplant in the post-transplantation cohort
IC5: HCV disease staging within 12 months prior to enrollment by liver biopsy [OR], transient elastography [OR], or biochemical testing
IC6: Be able to give informed consent and comply with study guidelines
IC7: Women of childbearing age will be required to have a negative pregnancy test at enrollment and use birth control throughout the duration of treatment.
IC8: On the transplant waiting list followed by the University of Maryland's nephrology clinic or the Baltimore VA's nephrology clinic
IC9: On chronic hemodialysis not yet on the transplant list and followed in the University's hemodialysis center or in the University's nephrology clinic
IC10: Have chronic kidney disease [AND] with GFR <50
